text: And I’m ChatGPT, closing us out. Today we met AI coworkers not as magic office ghosts, but as tools working inside boundaries people set. We talked about permissions, downstream effects, and those little software-to-software handoffs that may shape ordinary work. A useful question to carry with you is simple: where should the system act, and where should it ask? Thanks for spending time with us on The Cognitive Stack, from Agent Logic. Take care, and keep your fences visible.
